!is.numeric(S)) {     stop("`S` must be a numeric matrix.")   }   if (!all(dim(Y) == dim(S))) {     stop("`Y` and `S` must have the same dimensions.")   }   if (any(S < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {     stop("`S` must be nonnegative.")   }      if (length(nu) == 1L) {     if (!is.numeric(nu) || is.na(nu) || nu <= 0) {       stop("`nu` must be a positive number.")     }     nu_mat <- matrix(nu, nrow = nrow(Y), ncol = ncol(Y))   } else {     if (!is.matrix(nu) || !is.numeric(nu) || !all(dim(nu) == dim(Y))) {       stop("`nu` must be either a positive scalar or a numeric matrix with the same dimensions as `Y`.")     }     if (any(nu <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {       stop("All entries of `nu` must be positive.")     }     nu_mat <- nu   }      z_t <- Y / S      # Main calculation:   # S_tilde = S * z_t / qnorm(pt(z_t, df = nu))   p_t <- pt(z_t, df = nu_mat)   z_n <- qnorm(p_t)      S_tilde <- S * z_t / z_n      # Numerical fix for z_t close to 0:   # limit of z / qnorm(pt(z, df=nu)) as z -> 0 is dnorm(0) / dt(0, df=nu)   near_zero <- is.finite(z_t) & abs(z_t) < tol   if (any(near_zero, na.rm = TRUE)) {     limit_factor <- dnorm(0) / dt(0, df = nu_mat[near_zero])     S_tilde[near_zero] <- S[near_zero] * limit_factor   }      # Preserve zeros   zero_se <- (S == 0) & !is.na(S)   if (any(zero_se)) {     S_tilde[zero_se] <- 0   }      dimnames(S_tilde) <- dimnames(S)   S_tilde } S <- text: observe data matrix X=(xij)∈ℝn×d, X = (x_{ij}) \\mathbb{R}^{n \times d},  row ii one cell column jj one feature. single-ordering MPCurve model assumes: cell latent position ci∈{1,…,K}, c_i \\{1,\dots,K\}, feature smooth trajectory KK ordered components, written 𝐮j=(uj1,…,ujK)⊤∈ℝK, \boldsymbol{u}_j = (u_{j1},\dots,u_{jK})^\top \\mathbb{R}^K, observations follow Gaussian likelihood xij∣ci=k,𝐮j,σj2∼N(ujk,σj2), x_{ij} \mid c_i = k, \boldsymbol{u}_j, \sigma_j^2 \sim N(u_{jk}, \sigma_j^2), trajectory regularized Gaussian Markov random field prior along component axis: 𝐮j∼N(0,(λjQK)−1), \boldsymbol{u}_j \sim N\!\left(0, (\lambda_j Q_K)^{-1}\right),  QKQ_K random-walk precision matrix KK bins. current cavi implementation: sigma_j^2 feature-specific, lambda_j feature-specific, covariance model homoskedastic across components, posterior approximated mean-field family q(C,U)=∏=1nqi(ci)∏j=1dqj(𝐮j). q(C,U) = \prod_{=1}^n q_i(c_i)\prod_{j=1}^d q_j(\boldsymbol{u}_j).
